reason: In OrchardCore.ContentPreview's contentpreview.edit.js (source, minified, and map) the keyup handler param is not renamed to e but the condition uses e.key, causing a ReferenceError on every keystroke that will break the backspace-triggered live preview and spam console errors, whereas the same refactor in OrchardCore.Templates correctly renamed the parameter.
